description: Figure 5 presents three pie charts. The first pie chart, labeled (a), shows the Persona similarity heatmap, which is not described in the image. The second pie chart, labeled (b), is titled "P6: Matching statistics" and represents the distribution of matching answers per question across personas, grouped by frequency. The third pie chart, labeled (c), is titled "P6: Tok-5 unique answer items" and shows the distribution of unique answer items for Persona 6.
